place_name: Lincoln Lake Slabs, Mt. Blue Sky (Mt. Evans), CO

evidence.fact: Rock features 'about 1000 feet above (right next to the road)'; park in small pulloffs on the dropoff side; no walk time.
Photo caption: trail down to Lincoln Lake Slabs starts from the pulloff; times on page are for Aprons/Black Wall only.
theCrag sector page (29 routes, ~12,000-12,350 ft) has no approach text.

note: No page states minutes. MP's 'right next to the road' sits beside 'about 1000 feet above' and stephabegg says a trail goes DOWN to the slabs, so 'roadside' is ambiguous; prior crag call rested on that phrase. Route types from MP area list (Ewoks MP grade 5.12b/c vs ours 5.11+, Codeine 5.12a/b vs 5.12-; names match exactly). Toll road, timed entry.

place_name: Power Dome, East Face, Courtright Reservoir, CA

evidence.fact: Park 1/8 mile east of the dam, hike east into Pemstemon Creek basin, follow slabs south to the dome; no time.
Dome visible to the right from Courtright Rd; no walk time.
Times given only for Penstemon Dome (15 min) and Trapper Dome (10 min), not Power Dome.

note: Still no stated time. Types from MP East Face list (S/T codes; classics confirm S=Sport).

place_name: East Cottage Dome (Erratic Dome), West Face, Tuolumne Meadows, CA

evidence.fact: West Face approach: trail and ducks to dome base, then class 2-3 scramble; no walk time.
Park in dirt pullout 2.7 mi west of Tuolumne store; hike up slabs; no time.
'a short cross-country walk' to the dome base; Miles and Est. Time fields blank.

note: Only 'short cross-country walk' (no minutes). SuperTopo route pages (likely to state a time) were unreachable (connection refused). Unknown A: MP grade 5.10c/d vs ours 5.10a/b, name matches.

place_name: Yucca Flower Tower, Echo Canyon, Sandia Mountains, NM
approach_stated: continue 10 minutes or about 0.3 miles on the main trail (only the leg after the 0.5 mi spur)

evidence.fact: Crest Spur trail .5 miles to La Luz junction; no time stated for this leg.
From the junction 'continue 10 minutes or about 0.3 miles' on La Luz to the rap; then rappel in.
Route page states no approach time; Trad, 3 pitches.

note: Only a partial leg is timed (10 min); the 0.5 mi spur is untimed and the rule forbids adding legs. Strong crag lean, top-down from paved-road parking. Western Justice listed 'Trad, TR' on MP; primary Trad.

place_name: The Toiyabe Fitzroy, Wild Granites, Western Nevada

evidence.fact: Approach listed as 1 hour and 2,100 vertical feet on a cairned trail from the end of the dirt road.

note: Stated time is exactly 60 min (meets the <=60 line), but 2,100 ft gain to a 1200 ft, up to 10-pitch dome; classics MP-tagged 'Trad, Alpine'. Page does not say routes top out; descent via rappels. Owner may still prefer alpine. Trident listed T (Trad).

place_name: Dusy Dome, Courtright Reservoir, Western Sierra, CA

evidence.fact: Follow trail to Penstemon, skirt its right shoulder, faint trail to the base; no walk time.
Penstemon Dome has 'only a 15 minute approach'; Dusy has no time given.

note: Dusy lies beyond Penstemon (15 min), but no page states the time to Dusy itself; adding legs not allowed.

place_name: Dog's Crag, Ice Lakes Basin, South Mineral Creek, Silverton, CO
from: parking at first switchback of Clear Lake Road

evidence.fact: 'This wall is at the top of the trail'; refers to Ice Lakes Crag directions; no time or distance.
Long trail description up Ice Lakes Trail to open meadow below crag; no time, 0 comments.

note: No time found; high (11,500 ft) basin crag up a steep trail, likely >1 h but not stated.

place_name: Black Bluff - West Face, Bluff Mesa, Big Bear Lake, CA
from: parking before Bluff Mesa Group Campground

evidence.fact: 'about 1.5 miles following the cairns' from the campground; easy to get lost; no time.
Bluff Mesa crags: 'long approach' from Bluff Mesa Campground or end of FR 2N86; no time.
Corner Boulder is reached 'after about 10-15 minutes' on the Black Bluff trail (partial leg only).

place_name: Melting Mud West, East Hellgate, Little Cottonwood Canyon, UT
approach_stated: takes about 5 minutes of steep switchbacking to reach the Melting Mud Wall
from: parking across from Alta Peruvian Lodge

Getting there 'same as all East Hellgate Climbs'; all 9 routes Sport incl. The Rise of Punk.

place_name: East Temple (aka The Beta), Pyramids of Pleiades, Tahquitz backcountry ('The Others'), San Jacinto Mtns, CA

evidence.fact: Approach same as Altar of Algoot plus ~100 yards up the Altar couloir; just below Tahquitz Peak fire lookout; no time.
Devils Slide trail to Saddle Junction, PCT south, South Ridge trail to Tahquitz Peak lookout, drop down north slope; no time.
Devils Slide trail is 2.5 miles Humber Park to Saddle Junction; no time stated.

note: Approach goes to the Tahquitz Peak lookout via 3 trails (first leg alone 2.5 mi) in the San Jacinto Wilderness; suggests >1 h but no page states a time. No route type gaps.

place_name: South Dome (flank of Mt Temple), Lion Creek Drainage, Selkirk Crest, North Idaho
approach_stated: The approach is short (30min or less), and well marked w/cairns.
from: parking at Lion Creek water slides (end of Lion Creek Road)

evidence.fact: Photo caption: 'The approach is short (30min or less), and well marked w/cairns.' Location: 'Not too long and not too hard'.
Park at Lion Creek water slides, cross creek, cairned boulder/scree hike to base of slabs; dome visible from the road.

note: Time is from a photo caption on the Lion King route page. Routes are long (Lion King 15 pitches, 1300 ft) on a mountain flank, descent by rappel/walk-off, not a summit. No route type gaps.

place_name: The Rain Cave, Wolverine Bowl, Bridger Range, MT
approach_stated: From the parking lot it is a 1 hour hike to Wolverine (45min if hiking quickly).

evidence.fact: 'From the parking lot it is a 1 hour hike to Wolverine (45min if hiking quickly).'
From the meadow, climbers trail past Lower Replica then faint scree trail up to the cave; no time.

note: Borderline: stated time (45-60 min) is to Wolverine, the crag; the cave is a short untimed uphill beyond the Lower Replica, which could push it past 60. Single-pitch sport, no summit.

'Follow death march as if you are going to Hinterland Buttress'; no time.
Hinterland approached from the bottom of North Gully around Diamond Back Buttress; no time.
